items.title: William "Ba Ba" Ridgley Interview, 1961-04-11
items.q: You mean when Baby Dodge was with us?

ctx.x: Now he was, Sails was on the boat with us. He was on the boat with us?
Yeah. You mean when Baby Dodge was with you?
Well, yeah. May I say that, did he? I believe he was on that boat with us.
